dossier.headline: Tata Power's Q2 profit jumps; reports differ on the size
dossier.summary: Tata Power reported September-quarter results after market hours on November 11. Upstox puts consolidated profit at ₹1,366 crore, up 49%, with EBITDA up 11% to ₹3,668 crore and the margin down to 18.7%; another report puts profit at ₹1,652 crore, up 33%, on revenue of ₹19,886 crore. Before the results, brokers had estimated profit between about ₹1,010 crore and ₹1,420 crore.
